heard: This smiling salamander can regrow its brain, yet it is nearly gone. Known as the axolotl, this aquatic amphibian keeps its external gills and never leaves the water. Beyond staying young forever, it can completely regenerate severed limbs, tails, and heart tissue. Nearly all laboratory pets trace back to a single 1864 shipment sent to Paris. Yet in the shrinking water channels of Lake Zocai Milco, the wild population has crashed. Invasive fish like tilapia were introduced and eat their eggs, adding to pollution and urban pressure. Current surveys show that only about 50 to 1,000 adult axolotls survive in the wild. This smiling salamander faces a fight to stay on Earth.
differences: 'xochimilco' heard as 'zocai milco' after 'channels of lake'
